title: Explain SQL Joins and Performance
hint: Distinguish INNER, LEFT OUTER, RIGHT OUTER, FULL OUTER, and CROSS joins, and explain how indexes optimize join operations.
keyPoints: INNER vs OUTER joins venn diagram mapping
Nested Loop Join vs Hash Join vs Merge Join algorithms

title: What is Dependency Injection?
hint: Explain Inversion of Control (IoC), decoupling dependencies, constructor vs setter injection, and ease of unit testing with mocks.

title: How does Garbage Collection work in V8?
hint: Detail Generational Garbage Collection (Young Generation / Scavenge vs Old Generation / Mark-Sweep-Compact) and memory leaks.
keyPoints: Scavenger algorithm & Cheney copying in Nursery
Mark-Sweep and Mark-Compact in Old Space
Common JS memory leaks (unclosed closures, detached DOM, global scope)

title: Explain ACID Transactions
hint: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability — what each guarantees and how databases implement them.
keyPoints: Isolation levels and anomalies (dirty, non-repeatable, phantom)

title: REST vs gRPC: when to use which?
hint: Compare HTTP/JSON + REST vs HTTP/2 + Protobuf, focusing on tooling, performance, streaming, and contract evolution.
keyPoints: Wire formats: text JSON vs binary Protobuf

title: Caching Strategies in Backend Systems
hint: Cover cache-aside, read-through, write-through, write-behind, and invalidation patterns.

title: Authentication vs Authorization
hint: Authentication proves identity; authorization grants access. Cover session, JWT, OAuth2, OIDC.

title: What is an Idempotent Endpoint?
hint: Explain how idempotency keys prevent duplicate side effects on retries, with examples from payments and queues.
keyPoints: HTTP methods: GET, PUT, DELETE are idempotent
